text.p: Dillon Read & Co Inc said analyst Bruce Roberts started coverage of competitive local exchange carrier (CLEC) Brooks Fiber Properties Inc with an outperform rating.
-- In a report, Roberts said the company is well financed and well run, and is the first CLEC to show success in running a local telephone market with unbundled local loops.
-- Brooks Fiber is likely to achieve steady-state EBITDA, net income and free cash flow profitability much earlier than other CLECs, he said, making it a low-risk stock.
-- Roberts said he expects company-wide postive EBITDA in 1998, "earlier than any other company in our universe."
-- Shares rose 1/2 to 34-1/2 in the first few minutes of trading.
